% Pattern: attach/case. "Proof of case (i)" inside a proof is a part of that
% proof and proves what the proof proves. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=thm-1
% want head-1 proof - proves=thm-1
% want head-2 proof - proves=thm-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{thm} Every compact space is bounded. \end{thm}
\begin{proof} We show two cases.

{\it Proof of case (i).} The space is finite, so it is bounded.

{\it Proof of case (ii).} Cover the space by finitely many balls.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
